objective.name: sandbox.dsl.switch.remote.meaning.default
objective.description: Use remote meaning.query and fall through to a switch default route when no projected row matches.

#root.role: Refresh the remote projection, query a missing remote projected element, then use >switch default to choose the terminal local route.

effects.remote_projection_refresh: The remote projection is refreshed before the missing query.
effects.empty_remote_query: The remote query yields no matching row.
effects.default_terminal_route: The switch default route provides the terminal response.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local DSL request becomes one default-branch terminal response after a remote reflective selection yields no row.
invariants: The flow refreshes and queries the remote projection before evaluating the DSL switch.
The switch discriminator is expected to be absent because the remote query intentionally yields no row.
The >default terminal route is the intended success path for this scenario.
success: On success, the terminal payload is the payload returned by the local default sandbox.echo route.
Successful execution proves that an empty remote selection can still drive deterministic default routing.
failure: The flow fails if the remote rebuild, remote query, or the default terminal route cannot complete.
The scenario is invalid only if the remote query unexpectedly cannot be evaluated at all, not merely because it returns no rows.
notes: This scenario exists specifically to validate switch default behavior on empty reflective selections.
The remote miss is deliberate and part of the scenario contract.
